title: rosa canina subvar. sarmentoides
intro: Rosa canina subvar. sarmentoides, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, characterized by its climbing or trailing habit. The health benefits of Rosa canina subvar. sarmentoides include its ability to support cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as a diuretic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions, including digestive issues and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina subvar. sarmentoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
